    The opposite ray category #

    Pᵒᵖ is again a finite ray category (RayCat.isFiniteRayCategory_op); irreducible morphisms correspond, paths reverse (RayCat.revPath), and so do interlacing and essential contours. Chains of P with offset o are chains of Pᵒᵖ with offset o + 1, with the same efficiency; this turns a tackle of P whose last link is a peak into one of Pᵒᵖ whose last link is a valley (Fischbacher's "bis auf Dualität").

    Quiver.Hom.unop (f ^ n) = CategoryTheory.End.of (Quiver.Hom.unop f) ^ n
